description: DIVADA, five clock dividers that share nothing but a reset, with prime and power-of-two division ratios

params.text: Sets the division for that divider, snapping to 2, 3, 4, 5, 7, 8, 11, 13, 16, 17, 19 or 23
Returns all five counters to the start of their divisions

inputs.text: The clock counted by that divider, which advances its count on each rising edge
A rising edge returns all five counters to the start of their divisions

outputs.text: Carries 10V over the first half of the division and 0V over the rest; with an odd division the low part is one count the longer

notes: Nothing is normalled between the five rows, so a divider with no cable in its own input never counts
